matching_rule: A planted risk matches a reported risk only when at least one referenced clause contains an expected section number and an exact quote contains the planted quote anchor (whitespace/case/smart-quote normalization only). Cross-clause recall additionally requires at least two distinct referenced clause IDs.

risk_recall.metric: matched planted risks / total planted risks

cross_clause_recall.metric: matched planted cross-clause risks / total planted cross-clause risks

quote_grounding_rate.metric: reported risk quotes present in source / reported risk quotes

citation_precision.metric: eligible cited authorities resolving to authority-bank entries / eligible cited authorities

cal_bpc_16600_support_check.metric: independent support check against loaded statute text

cal_civ_1798_100_support_check.metric: independent support check against loaded statute text
